results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: This news article reports on a computational social science study led by sociologist Fabio Giglietto. The research, which analyzed over 2.5 million Facebook posts, found that Meta's policies to reduce political content disproportionately cut the reach of mainstream democratic representatives by 72% while leaving extremist accounts highly visible. The findings were featured on the investigative TV show 'Report' on Rai3 and triggered a formal inquiry in the European Parliament.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: This university press and media release outlines Fabio Giglietto's research ('A Pretty Blunt Approach') detailing how Meta's algorithms downranked visibility for elected officials. It explains how his scientific findings on algorithmic reduction and democratic risks led to formal parliamentary questions directed at the European Commission.

results.title: Research Radio
results.snippet: An ongoing AI-assisted podcast series curated by Fabio Giglietto. The podcast features structured deep dives into computational social science, misinformation, state-backed propaganda, and the dynamics of alternative digital media ecosystems.
